usage:
Oobee version: {{version}}
Usage: npm run cli -- -c <crawler> -d <device> -w <viewport> -u <url> OPTIONS

examples.title: Examples:
examples.custom: To start a custom flow scan

options.c: Type of scan, 1) sitemap, 2) website crawl, 3) custom flow, 4) intelligent 5) local file
options.u: Website URL you want to scan
options.w: Viewport width (in pixels) you want to scan
options.p: Maximum number of pages to scan (default: 100). Only available in website and sitemap scans
options.f: Disable dynamically clicking of page buttons and links to find links, which resolve issues on some websites. [yes / no]
options.h: Run the scan in headless mode. [yes / no]
options.b: Browser to run the scan on: 1) Chromium, 2) Chrome, 3) Edge. Defaults to Chrome on Windows and macOS (and on Linux when Chrome is installed), otherwise the bundled Chromium.
options.s: Controls crawl and redirect scope. Defaults to "same-domain" for all scan types. Sitemap scans keep every listed URL and child sitemap; only "same-hostname" on a remote sitemap filters them to the entry hostname (www/non-www count as the same host). "ignore" (remote sitemap scans only) also stops scoping redirects.
options.e: Preferred directory to store scan results. Path is relative to your home directory.
options.j: Give Custom Flow Scan a label for easier reference in the report
options.k: To personalise your experience, we will be collecting your name, email address and app usage data. Your information fully complies with GovTech’s Privacy Policy. Please provide your name and email address in this format "John Doe:john@domain.com". Optional when OOBEE_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 is set.
options.t: Maximum number of pages to scan concurrently. Use for sites with throttling. Defaults to 3 × available CPUs (min 2, max 25).
options.i: File types to include in the scan. Defaults to html-only.
options.x: Txt file that has a list of pattern of domains to exclude from accessibility scan separated by new line
options.a:
Additional features to include in the report: 
screenshots - Include element screenshots in the generated report 
none - Exclude all additional features in the generated report
options.q: Json string that contains additional scan metadata for telemetry purposes. Defaults to "{}"
options.r: Crawler adheres to robots.txt rules if it exists. [yes / no]
options.m: The HTTP authentication header keys and their respective values to enable crawler access to restricted resources.
options.y: Specify scan ruleset for accessibility checks
options.g:
Generate two gzipped and base64-encoded JSON files containing the results of the accessibility scan:

1. scanData.json.gz.b64: Provides an overview of the scan, including:
   - WCAG compliance score
   - Violated WCAG clauses
   - Metadata (e.g., scan start and end times)
   - Pages scanned and skipped
2. scanItems.json.gz.b64: Contains detailed information about detected accessibility issues, including:
   - Severity levels
   - Issue descriptions
   - Related WCAG guidelines
   - URL of the pages violated the WCAG clauses
Useful for in-depth analysis or integration with external reporting tools.

To obtain the JSON files, you need to base64-decode the file followed by gunzip. For example:

(macOS) base64 -D -i scanData.json.gz.b64 | gunzip > scanData.json

(linux) base64 -d scanData.json.gz.b64 | gunzip > scanData.json
options.l: Maximum scan duration in seconds (0 means unlimited)
options.n: ISO 639-1 language code for the report and axe-core issue text (e.g. en, ja). Defaults to OOBEE_LANG env var, or en. Also sets the language of this help and CLI messages, which otherwise follow the terminal/OS language.
options.z: Tag to identify the website in telemetry. Overrides OOBEE_TAGGED_WEBSITE env var.

messages.enterIntegerOrKeyword: Please enter an integer (1 to {{count}}) or keywords ({{choices}}).
messages.invalidRuleset: Invalid values {{values}} for -y, --ruleset. Please provide valid values: {{choices}}.
messages.invalidDevice: Invalid device. Please provide an existing device to start the scan.
messages.invalidViewportNumber: Invalid viewport width. Please provide a number.
messages.invalidViewportRange: Invalid viewport width! Please provide a viewport width between 320-1080 pixels.
messages.invalidMaxPages: Invalid maximum number of pages. Please provide a positive integer.
messages.invalidConcurrency: Invalid number for max concurrency. Please provide a positive integer.
messages.nameEmailFormat: Invalid format. Please provide your name and email address separated by ":"
messages.invalidName: Invalid name. Please provide a valid name.
messages.invalidEmail: Invalid email address. Please provide a valid email address.
messages.invalidFileTypes: Invalid value for fileTypes. Please provide valid keywords: {{choices}}.
messages.invalidAdditional: Invalid value for additional. Please provide valid keywords: {{choices}}.
messages.maxPagesNotCustom: -p or --maxpages is only available in website, sitemap and local file scans.
messages.strategyScanTypes: -s or --strategy is only available in website, custom flow, intelligent, sitemap, and local file scans.
messages.strategyIgnoreSitemapOnly: -s ignore is only available for sitemap scans.
messages.invalidScanDuration: Invalid scan duration. Please provide a positive number of seconds.
